declaration.preface:
To support and align with the sustainability vision, responsible sourcing commitments, and strategic objectives of the Anthea Group, DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. has established this Sustainable Supply Chain Framework as a comprehensive approach for managing environmental, social, ethical, and governance considerations throughout its supply chain. The Framework promotes responsible procurement, supplier engagement, ethical sourcing, environmental stewardship, human rights, labour standards, and compliance with applicable laws and internationally recognized standards.

To facilitate the effective implementation of this Framework, the Company has also developed an internal Sustainable Supply Chain Roadmap, which translates the Group's responsible sourcing priorities into site-specific objectives, targets, action plans, and performance monitoring mechanisms. This Roadmap supports the continuous enhancement of supplier sustainability performance, responsible procurement practices, supply chain resilience, risk management, and collaborative value creation, while reinforcing the Company's commitment to responsible and sustainable business operations.

DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. recognizes that sustainable procurement is a key driver of responsible business growth and long-term value creation. As a manufacturer of specialty aroma chemicals, the Company is committed to integrating environmental, social, ethical, and governance (ESG) considerations into its procurement processes to ensure that goods, materials, and services are sourced in a responsible, transparent, and sustainable manner.

This Sustainable Supply Chain Framework establishes the Company's commitment to working collaboratively with suppliers, contractors, and service providers who share its values of environmental stewardship, ethical business conduct, respect for human rights, and regulatory compliance. Through responsible sourcing practices, supplier engagement, risk-based assessments, and continual improvement, DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. aims to strengthen the sustainability and resilience of its supply chain while creating positive value for its customers, employees, business partners, and the communities in which it operates.
declaration.declaration:
The objective of this Sustainable Supply Chain Framework is to establish a framework for integrating environmental, social, ethical, and governance (ESG) principles into the procurement activities of DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. and to promote responsible sourcing practices across its supply chain.

This policy aims to:

Ensure that procurement decisions consider environmental, social, ethical, quality, and business continuity aspects in addition to cost and performance.

Promote responsible sourcing by engaging suppliers who demonstrate compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, environmental, labour, human rights, and ethical requirements.

Encourage suppliers to adopt sustainable environmental practices, including efficient resource utilization, pollution prevention, waste reduction, climate action, and responsible chemical management.

Foster fair labour practices, respect for human rights, occupational health and safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout the supply chain.

Promote ethical business conduct by preventing bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, fraud, and other unethical practices within procurement activities.

Strengthen supplier sustainability performance through risk-based assessments, supplier evaluations, audits, corrective action plans, and continuous engagement.

Build long-term partnerships with suppliers that support innovation, transparency, resilience, and continual improvement in sustainability performance.

Contribute to the Company's sustainability objectives while creating long-term value for customers, employees, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
declaration.scope:

Ltd. and is applicable to all employees involved in purchasing and sourcing decisions, as well as suppliers, contractors, service providers, consultants, logistics partners, and other business associates engaged by the Company.

The scope of this policy covers all operational locations of the Company, including:

policy.monitoring:
DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. shall establish and maintain a systematic process for monitoring and reporting the implementation and effectiveness of this Green Procurement Policy. Reporting shall include supplier sustainability assessments, supplier environmental and social performance, procurement-related ESG indicators, supplier audits, corrective action plans, training activities, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and Company requirements.

The Procurement Department, in coordination with relevant functions, shall periodically review supplier sustainability performance and report progress against the Company's sustainable procurement objectives and targets to the Management. Relevant records and documentation shall be maintained to support internal audits, customer requirements, management reviews, regulatory compliance, and continual improvement of the sustainable procurement program.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Sustainable Supply Chain Framework shall be reviewed at least once every year, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable laws and regulations, business operations, supply chain risks, stakeholder expectations, or the Company's sustainability objectives. The review shall ensure that the policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with the Company's sustainable procurement commitments and business strategy.

The review shall be coordinated by the Procurement Department, in consultation with relevant functions, and approved by the Management. Any revisions to the policy shall be communicated to all relevant employees, suppliers, contractors, and other applicable stakeholders to support effective implementation and continual improvement of the Company's sustainable procurement practices.
